name: Women in STEM High School Outreach Program
what_you_do: Join a year-long program about STEM careers. You go to campus events, tour labs, meet advisors and mentors, and build a plan for college.
who_can_apply: Nevada high school juniors and seniors. The program is aimed most at girls and young women who have faced barriers to STEM learning and research.
pay_detail: Cost and pay are not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The program page lists the 2024 to 2025 application, which opened June 1, 2024 and stayed open until spots were full. No newer dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply now link on the Join Women in STEM page. A paper form can be picked up at the Dean's Office, 4th floor of the Davidson Mathematics and Science Center on campus.
notes: The program page still shows the 2024 to 2025 year. Check with the program before you plan on it. It asks for four events in each of three event series, two advisor meetings and three mentor meetings during the year.
